author: Learn Linux TV
description:
Raspberry Pi OS has come a long way! In this video, we’ll take a complete tour of Raspberry Pi OS in 2026, exploring its features, desktop environment, applications, and customization options.

Whether you’re brand new to Raspberry Pi or an experienced Linux user, you’ll learn how to install Raspberry Pi OS, navigate the desktop, manage software, and configure the operating system to your liking.
